{{Top|leg}}
A '''Flatscreen''' was a panel that measured meter wide and half meter high that decorated the buildings of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. They showed two-dimensional images that were usually recorded from [[flatcam]]s.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
